_comment: Hosting config for prakrutik-kheti-e9194 ONLY. Kept in its own folder, with no
database block, because the firebase.json in the parent folder deploys DATABASE
RULES - running a plain `firebase deploy` there would overwrite the live security
rules. Nothing in here can touch the database.
WHY THIS EXISTS: prakrutik-kheti-e9194.web.app is the Farm Verification project's
own hosting address, but it was serving a STALE COPY OF KHEDUT HAAT (57 KB, no
version marker, against the real 80 KB V8.7 on sristikheduthaat.in). That old
client was talking to the live Khedut Haat database, and its config is where the
wrong appId in Farm Verification came from (fixed in app v183).
It redirects rather than being deleted so that anyone still holding an old link -
including /submit and /admin, which both answered 200 - lands on the real, current
shop instead of a dead page. The path is carried across, so /submit goes to
(run from this folder; --only hosting is belt-and-braces)

redirects._why: The catch-all below does NOT match the bare root - verified on a preview channel, where / served the fallback file instead of redirecting. This explicit rule handles it. Keep it FIRST.

Everything else, carrying the path across: /submit -> sristikheduthaat.in/submit. Firebase serves its own reserved /__/auth/handler ahead of this, verified on the preview channel - which matters because that is the Firebase Auth endpoint.
